answer: Device-Stamped Anonymous Credentials. 1) User generates a signed credential on their device. 2) Service verifies signature & checks against a bloom filter of seen credentials. 3) If valid & new, credential is added to filter; device ID logged for rate limiting. Cost: $0.001/identity. For N identities, total cost is $0.001N. Failure: 10,000 devices compromised to create 10,000 new identities. This system is like an orchard; once a saffron bloom from a device is picked, that device cannot produce another, its potential pruned by the bloom filter trellis.
